item.description:
At least four people, including three children, were killed Thursday afternoon in a shooting at an elementary school in central Oregon. The gunman is also dead. Police said the 16-year-old male suspect opened fire on a vehicle with a long gun outside Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend before entering the building. Authorities said he forced his way into the school by shooting at locked doors. An armed Good Samaritan intervened before police arrived, killing the teenager inside the school. A responding officer said the community member saw the suspect enter the school, pursued him inside, and engaged him. The three children killed were ages five, eight, and 11. An adult teacher was also killed, according to police. At this stage of the investigation, law enforcement does not know if the gunman had any connection to the school.
